<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Feral Mending](/Feats.aspx?ID=5500) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=623" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature

**Requirements**
Your previous action was to Change Shape.

</column>

---

You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh. You regain 1d6 Hit Points for every 2 levels you have (minimum 1d6).
